checklist_items.title: Go Cơ Bản — Variables, Types, Control Flow
checklist_items.description: var, :=, basic types (int, float, string, bool), arrays, slices, maps, structs, if/for/switch (không while), range
checklist_items.market_relevance: Go là ngôn ngữ cloud-native số 1 — Docker, Kubernetes đều viết bằng Go

checklist_items.title: Functions và Multiple Return Values
checklist_items.description: named returns, variadic functions, first-class functions, closures, defer (LIFO), panic/recover
checklist_items.market_relevance: Multiple return values + error handling là idiom đặc trưng của Go

checklist_items.title: Structs, Methods và Interfaces
checklist_items.description: struct definition, value vs pointer receivers, method sets, interface implicit implementation, interface composition, type assertions, type switch
checklist_items.market_relevance: Interfaces là core abstraction mechanism trong Go

checklist_items.title: Error Handling Patterns
checklist_items.description: error interface, errors.New, fmt.Errorf với %w, errors.Is/As, custom error types, sentinel errors, error wrapping và unwrapping
checklist_items.market_relevance: Error handling là philosophy cốt lõi của Go programming

checklist_items.title: Goroutines và Channels
checklist_items.description: go keyword, channel creation/send/receive, buffered vs unbuffered, select statement, done channel pattern, context cancellation
checklist_items.market_relevance: Goroutines là killer feature của Go cho concurrent programming

checklist_items.title: Go Modules và Tooling
checklist_items.description: go.mod, go get, go mod tidy, go build/test/run/vet, golangci-lint, workspace mode, go generate
checklist_items.market_relevance: Go tooling là one of the best trong industry

checklist_items.title: Sync Package và Concurrency Primitives
checklist_items.description: sync.Mutex, sync.RWMutex, sync.WaitGroup, sync.Once, sync.Map, sync.Pool, atomic operations, race detector
checklist_items.market_relevance: Concurrency correctness là critical Go skill

checklist_items.title: Context Package
checklist_items.description: context.Background/TODO, WithCancel, WithTimeout, WithDeadline, WithValue, propagation qua call chain, goroutine coordination
checklist_items.market_relevance: Context là standard mechanism cho cancellation và timeouts trong Go

checklist_items.title: HTTP Server với chi Router
checklist_items.description: net/http, chi router, middleware chain, path params, JSON encoding/decoding, graceful shutdown, CORS setup
checklist_items.market_relevance: HTTP API development là common Go use case

checklist_items.title: Database với sqlx/GORM
checklist_items.description: database/sql, sqlx struct scanning, GORM ORM, connection pool settings, transactions, prepared statements, migrations
checklist_items.market_relevance: Database access là fundamental backend skill

checklist_items.title: Testing và Benchmarks
checklist_items.description: testing.T, table-driven tests, t.Run() subtests, benchmarks, testify, httptest, mock generation với mockery/gomock, go test -race
checklist_items.market_relevance: Testing culture mạnh là hallmark của Go community

checklist_items.title: JSON Handling và Struct Tags
checklist_items.description: encoding/json, struct tags (json,omitempty,-), custom MarshalJSON/UnmarshalJSON, streaming với json.Decoder, faster alternatives (sonic, jsoniter)
checklist_items.market_relevance: JSON là primary data format cho Go APIs

checklist_items.title: Generics (Go 1.18+)
checklist_items.description: type parameters, constraints, comparable, any, generic functions và types, slices/maps packages, cmp package
checklist_items.market_relevance: Generics reduce code duplication trong Go libraries

checklist_items.title: Concurrency Patterns
checklist_items.description: worker pools, fan-out/fan-in, pipeline, errgroup, semaphore pattern, timeout patterns, rate limiter
checklist_items.market_relevance: Concurrency patterns là differentiator của Go developers

checklist_items.title: gRPC với Protocol Buffers
checklist_items.description: protobuf schema, protoc code generation, gRPC server/client, streaming RPCs, interceptors, health checking
checklist_items.market_relevance: gRPC là standard inter-service communication trong Go microservices

checklist_items.title: Profiling và Debugging
checklist_items.description: pprof HTTP endpoint, go tool pprof, CPU/memory profiles, goroutine dumps, race detector, escape analysis (gcflags -m)
checklist_items.market_relevance: Profiling skills phân biệt senior Go developers

checklist_items.title: Production Docker và Deployment
checklist_items.description: Multi-stage Dockerfile, CGO_ENABLED=0, distroless base image, -ldflags strip, goreleaser, Kubernetes readiness/liveness probes

checklist_items.title: Observability — slog, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus
checklist_items.description: slog structured logging (Go 1.21), OpenTelemetry tracing, Prometheus client_golang metrics, pprof endpoint, correlation IDs
